```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 6,
  fig.height = 3.6
)
```

## What This File Shows

- Title, subtitle, footer, slide numbers, progress bar
- Section slides and incremental bullet fragments
- Markdown tables and executable R output
- Code blocks with line numbers and copy buttons
- A model code block with subsequent line highlighting
- Images, math, citations, and references
- A black-background interactive slider slide adapted from the main deck

::: notes
This is a compact smoke-test deck for styling and slide behavior.
:::

# Section Slide

## Incremental Content

::: {.incremental}
- The deck uses Quarto `revealjs`, matching `DyadicDataAnalysis.Rmd`.
- Citations come from `Embed/Temp.bib` and `Embed/Rpackages.bib`.
- Images are loaded from the existing `Embed/` folder.
:::

Dyadic data analysis often separates actor and partner effects [@kenny2006dyadic; @kennyPartnerEffectsRelationship1999].

## Markdown Table

| Element | Syntax | Purpose |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Section | `# Heading` | Creates a major section slide |
| Slide | `## Heading` | Creates a regular slide |
| Citation | `[@kenny2006dyadic]` | Renders bibliography-backed references |
| Math | `$b_a + b_p$` | Shows inline equations |

## R Table Output

```{r demo-table}
demo_data <- data.frame(
  dyad = 1:4,
  actor = c(0.2, 1.1, -0.4, 0.7),
  partner = c(0.5, 0.8, -0.1, 1.4)
)

demo_data$couple_mean <- rowMeans(demo_data[c("actor", "partner")])
knitr::kable(demo_data, digits = 2)
```



## Code Lines

```{r code-lines}
actor_effect <- 0.70
partner_effect <- 0.25

cbc_effect <- actor_effect + partner_effect
cwc_effect <- actor_effect - partner_effect

c(cbc = cbc_effect, cwc = cwc_effect)
```

## Model With Line Highlight Steps

Advance through this slide to highlight the data, model formula, fit call, and summary lines in sequence.

```{.r code-line-numbers="1-5|7-11|13-16|18-19"}
apim_data <- data.frame(
  outcome = c(4.8, 5.1, 3.9, 4.4, 5.7, 5.2),
  actor = c(0.2, 0.7, -0.4, 0.1, 1.0, 0.5),
  partner = c(0.5, 0.3, -0.2, 0.8, 0.6, 0.9)
)

apim_formula <- outcome ~
  actor +
  partner +
  I((actor + partner) / 2) +
  I((actor - partner) / 2)

apim_fit <- lm(
  formula = apim_formula,
  data = apim_data
)

summary(apim_fit)
coef(apim_fit)
```

plot(

```

## Math

The APIM-to-DIM reparameterization can be expressed as:

$$
x_{cbc} = \frac{x_{actor} + x_{partner}}{2}
$$

$$
x_{cwc} = \frac{x_{actor} - x_{partner}}{2}
$$

<div class="sumdiff-demo">

    </div>

    <div class="sd-group">

<div id="sd-coefs" data-b0="2.25" data-ba="0.70" data-bp="0.25"></div>

<script>
(function(){
  const root = document.currentScript.closest('section');
  const MIN = -5, MAX = 5, PLOT_DOMAIN = 5;
  const c = {actor:'#4E94F8', partner:'#A78BFA', cbc:'#E26A5C', cwc:'#FBBF24'};
  const coefData = root.querySelector('#sd-coefs').dataset;
  const b0 = Number(coefData.b0), bA = Number(coefData.ba), bP = Number(coefData.bp);
  const bCbc = +(bA + bP).toFixed(2);
  const bCwc = +(bA - bP).toFixed(2);
  const el = id => root.querySelector('#' + id);
  const actor = el('sd-actor'), partner = el('sd-partner'), cbc = el('sd-cbc'), cwc = el('sd-cwc');
  const outA = el('sd-out-actor'), outP = el('sd-out-partner'), outCbc = el('sd-out-cbc'), outCwc = el('sd-out-cwc');
  const eqA = el('sd-eq-apim'), eqD = el('sd-eq-dim'), eqC = el('sd-eq-coef');
  const point = el('sd-point'), halo = el('sd-halo'), svg = el('sd-svg');
  const r1 = x => Math.round(Number(x) * 10) / 10;
  const clamp = (x, lo, hi) => Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, Number(x)));
  const xPix = x => 160 + x * (130 / PLOT_DOMAIN);
  const yPix = y => 160 - y * (130 / PLOT_DOMAIN);
  const num = (x, color = null, result = false) => {
    const value = Math.abs(x) < 1e-10 ? 0 : x;
    const sign = value < 0 ? '-' : '<span class="sd-sign-pad" aria-hidden="true"></span>';
    const style = color ? ` style="color:${color}"` : '';
    const cls = result ? 'sd-result' : 'sd-num';
    return `<span class="${cls}"${style}>${sign}${Math.abs(value).toFixed(2)}</span>`;
  };
  const beta = name => `<span class="sd-beta">b<sub>${name}</sub></span>`;

  function feasibleA(p){ return [Math.max(MIN, 2 * MIN - p, 2 * MIN + p), Math.min(MAX, 2 * MAX - p, 2 * MAX + p)]; }
  function feasibleP(a){ return [Math.max(MIN, 2 * MIN - a, a - 2 * MAX), Math.min(MAX, 2 * MAX - a, a - 2 * MIN)]; }
  function feasibleM(w){ return [Math.max(MIN, MIN - w, MIN + w), Math.min(MAX, MAX - w, MAX + w)]; }
  function feasibleW(m){ return [Math.max(MIN, MIN - m, m - MAX), Math.min(MAX, MAX - m, m - MIN)]; }

  function setFromAP(a, p){
    const aClamped = r1(clamp(a, MIN, MAX));
    const pClamped = r1(clamp(p, MIN, MAX));
    actor.value = aClamped;
    partner.value = pClamped;
    cbc.value = r1((aClamped + pClamped) / 2);
    cwc.value = r1((aClamped - pClamped) / 2);
    render();
  }
  function setFromDIM(m, w){
    const mClamped = r1(clamp(m, ...feasibleM(w)));
    const wClamped = r1(clamp(w, ...feasibleW(mClamped)));
    cbc.value = mClamped;
    cwc.value = wClamped;
    actor.value = r1(mClamped + wClamped);
    partner.value = r1(mClamped - wClamped);
    render();
  }
  function moveActor(){ setFromAP(r1(clamp(actor.value, ...feasibleA(r1(partner.value)))), r1(partner.value)); }
  function movePartner(){ setFromAP(r1(actor.value), r1(clamp(partner.value, ...feasibleP(r1(actor.value))))); }
  function moveCbc(){ setFromDIM(r1(clamp(cbc.value, ...feasibleM(r1(cwc.value)))), r1(cwc.value)); }
  function moveCwc(){ setFromDIM(r1(cbc.value), r1(clamp(cwc.value, ...feasibleW(r1(cbc.value))))); }

  function render(){
    const a = Number(actor.value), p = Number(partner.value), m = Number(cbc.value), w = Number(cwc.value);
    outA.value = a.toFixed(1);
    outP.value = p.toFixed(1);
    outCbc.value = m.toFixed(2);
    outCwc.value = w.toFixed(2);
    const yA = b0 + bA * a + bP * p;
    const yD = b0 + bCbc * m + bCwc * w;
    eqA.innerHTML = `<span class="sd-var">Yhat</span> = ${num(b0)} + ${num(bA)} x ${num(a, c.actor)} + ${num(bP)} x ${num(p, c.partner)} = ${num(yA, null, true)}`;
    eqD.innerHTML = `<span class="sd-var">Yhat</span> = ${num(b0)} + ${num(bCbc)} x ${num(m, c.cbc)} + ${num(bCwc)} x ${num(w, c.cwc)} = ${num(yD, null, true)}`;
    eqC.innerHTML = `${beta('cbc')} = ${num(bA)} + ${num(bP)} = ${num(bCbc)}; ${beta('cwc')} = ${num(bA)} - ${num(bP)} = ${num(bCwc)}`;
    point.setAttribute('cx', xPix(a));
    point.setAttribute('cy', yPix(p));
    halo.setAttribute('cx', xPix(a));
    halo.setAttribute('cy', yPix(p));
  }

  function drawGrid(){
    const ticks = [-4, -2, 0, 2, 4];
    let html = '';
    ticks.forEach(t => {
      const main = t === 0 ? 1.5 : 1;
      html += `<line x1="${xPix(t)}" y1="30" x2="${xPix(t)}" y2="290" stroke="${c.actor}" stroke-opacity="${t === 0 ? .48 : .20}" stroke-width="${main}" stroke-dasharray="${t === 0 ? '' : '2 2'}"></line>`;
      html += `<line x1="30" y1="${yPix(t)}" x2="290" y2="${yPix(t)}" stroke="${c.partner}" stroke-opacity="${t === 0 ? .48 : .20}" stroke-width="${main}" stroke-dasharray="${t === 0 ? '' : '2 2'}"></line>`;
      html += `<line x1="${xPix(-PLOT_DOMAIN)}" y1="${yPix(2*t + PLOT_DOMAIN)}" x2="${xPix(PLOT_DOMAIN)}" y2="${yPix(2*t - PLOT_DOMAIN)}" stroke="${c.cbc}" stroke-opacity="${t === 0 ? .50 : .22}" stroke-width="${main}" stroke-dasharray="${t === 0 ? '' : '3 3'}"></line>`;
      html += `<line x1="${xPix(-PLOT_DOMAIN)}" y1="${yPix(-PLOT_DOMAIN - 2*t)}" x2="${xPix(PLOT_DOMAIN)}" y2="${yPix(PLOT_DOMAIN - 2*t)}" stroke="${c.cwc}" stroke-opacity="${t === 0 ? .50 : .22}" stroke-width="${main}" stroke-dasharray="${t === 0 ? '' : '3 3'}"></line>`;
    });
    el('sd-grid-lines').innerHTML = html;
    el('sd-axis-labels').innerHTML = `
      <text x="286" y="148" fill="${c.actor}" font-size="12" font-style="italic" font-weight="800" text-anchor="end">x<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="8.5" font-style="normal">actor</tspan></text>
      <text x="150" y="22" fill="${c.partner}" font-size="12" font-style="italic" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle">x<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="8.5" font-style="normal">partner</tspan></text>
      <g transform="translate(${xPix(3.4)},${yPix(3.4)}) rotate(-45)"><text y="-7" fill="${c.cbc}" font-size="11" font-style="italic" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle">x<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="8" font-style="normal">cbc</tspan></text></g>
      <g transform="translate(${xPix(3.4)},${yPix(-3.4)}) rotate(45)"><text y="-7" fill="${c.cwc}" font-size="11" font-style="italic" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle">x<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="8" font-style="normal">cwc</tspan></text></g>`;
  }

  function gridToAP(evt){
    const rect = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    const pointEvent = evt.touches ? evt.touches[0] : evt;
    const sx = ((pointEvent.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 320;
    const sy = ((pointEvent.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 320;
    setFromAP(r1((sx - 160) / (130 / PLOT_DOMAIN)), r1((160 - sy) / (130 / PLOT_DOMAIN)));
  }
  let dragging = false;
  svg.addEventListener('mousedown', evt => { dragging = true; gridToAP(evt); });
  svg.addEventListener('mousemove', evt => { if (dragging) gridToAP(evt); });
  window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { dragging = false; });
  svg.addEventListener('touchstart', evt => { dragging = true; gridToAP(evt); }, {passive:true});
  svg.addEventListener('touchmove', evt => { if (dragging) gridToAP(evt); }, {passive:true});
  window.addEventListener('touchend', () => { dragging = false; });

  actor.addEventListener('input', moveActor);
  partner.addEventListener('input', movePartner);
  cbc.addEventListener('input', moveCbc);
  cwc.addEventListener('input', moveCwc);
  el('sd-reset').addEventListener('click', () => setFromAP(0, 0));
  el('sd-demo-mean').addEventListener('click', () => setFromAP(1, 1));
  el('sd-demo-deviation').addEventListener('click', () => setFromAP(1, -1));
  drawGrid();
  setFromAP(0, 0);
})();
</script>
```

## Complex Matrix Math

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mathbf{y}_{j}
&=
\begin{bmatrix}
y_{1j} \\
y_{2j}
\end{bmatrix}
=
\underbrace{
\begin{bmatrix}
1 & x_{1j} & x_{2j} & 0 \\
1 & x_{2j} & x_{1j} & 1
\end{bmatrix}
}_{\mathbf{X}_{j}}
\underbrace{
\begin{bmatrix}
\beta_{0} \\
\beta_{a} \\
\beta_{p} \\
\beta_{d}
\end{bmatrix}
}_{\boldsymbol{\beta}}
+
\underbrace{
\begin{bmatrix}
1 & x_{1j} & 0 \\
1 & 0 & x_{2j}
\end{bmatrix}
}_{\mathbf{Z}_{j}}
\underbrace{
\begin{bmatrix}
u_{0j} \\
u_{aj} \\
u_{pj}
\end{bmatrix}
}_{\mathbf{u}_{j}}
+
\boldsymbol{\varepsilon}_{j},
\\[1.1em]
\mathbf{u}_{j}
&\sim
\mathcal{N}
\left(
\begin{bmatrix}
0 \\
0 \\
0
\end{bmatrix},
\begin{bmatrix}
\sigma_{0}^{2} & \rho_{0a}\sigma_{0}\sigma_{a} & \rho_{0p}\sigma_{0}\sigma_{p} \\
\rho_{0a}\sigma_{0}\sigma_{a} & \sigma_{a}^{2} & \rho_{ap}\sigma_{a}\sigma_{p} \\
\rho_{0p}\sigma_{0}\sigma_{p} & \rho_{ap}\sigma_{a}\sigma_{p} & \sigma_{p}^{2}
\end{bmatrix}
\right),
\\[1.1em]
\boldsymbol{\varepsilon}_{j}
&\sim
\mathcal{N}
\left(
\begin{bmatrix}
0 \\
0
\end{bmatrix},
\begin{bmatrix}
\sigma_{e1}^{2} & \rho_{e}\sigma_{e1}\sigma_{e2} \\
\rho_{e}\sigma_{e1}\sigma_{e2} & \sigma_{e2}^{2}
\end{bmatrix}
\right).
\end{aligned}
$$
